This recognises the full unsupported-range and missing-fibre-estimate concern, although its presentation is broader and does not reproduce the exact smooth-function counterexample.

The gold issue is the absence of a uniform elliptic-regularity hypothesis for dual solutions across varying approximate domains. ISSUE-006 concerns the logical sharpness and necessity of a normal-error term in an H1 estimate, which is a different mathematical obligation.
